items.title: Widerspruch against contribution assessment
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Allgemeinen Musterkasse, Gesundheitsplatz 5, 30159 Musterstadt, zu erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 21.05.2026, sent by ordinary post by a social-insurance body (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X): deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Mon 25.05.2026 (this day does not shift for social-law letters even though it is Pfingstmontag). Counting of the one-month Widerspruchsfrist starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later, on the day with the same number, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB: Thu 25.06.2026. That day is a normal working day in NW, so no further shift applies.

items.computation: Voluntary membership and the assessed contribution start 01.06.2026. The letter states contributions are collected on the 15th of the month following the contribution month, so the first contribution (for June) is collected on 15.07.2026. 15.07.2026 is a Wednesday, a normal business day in NW, so no shift is needed.
